01 / Control surfaces

Built for staff workflows.

The interface pictured below includes modules for daily staff operations. The screenshots show the current UI and its described workflows; they are not a claim that every server-side subsystem is fully complete.

01Players & characters

Browse characters, target records, inspect state and launch inventory workflows.

02Items & equipment

Search native catalogs, prepare deliveries, filter equipment and inspect item records.

03World control

Configure temporary creature summons with destination, channel and duration settings.

04Messaging

Compose staff mail, prepare attachments and access announcement controls.

05Administration

Role-aware controls for bans, cash crediting and other privileged actions.

06Audit visibility

Staff action reasons and audit-log interfaces for traceable administration.

03 / Transparency

Development status.

Active development. Screenshots show an evolving staff console. The current UI explicitly notes that the native in-game mailbox is still being integrated, full combat behavior for certain summons is still being migrated, and custom native tooltips remain incomplete. Actual behavior should be verified against the corresponding Core build.
